messages.content: Let me check where your tech is.

function.name: get_job_arrival_status
function.description: Returns whether the tech is en route, has arrived, or hasn't left yet. Use when the customer asks 'where's my tech' or 'when will they get here'. Returns job_started_at, tech_en_route_at, scheduling_status, eta_ms. If tech_en_route_at is set + eta_ms is in the future, say 'your tech is on the way, ETA about X minutes'.

job_id.description: Job id from the customer's open_jobs list.
